faq.q: What is the origin of Badir?
faq.a: Badir is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of بدر. The source record's gloss 'Moon' is a reasonable rendering.
Yes — the underlying form بدر is Arabic.
Badir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Badir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. بدر occurs in the Qur'an (3:123) as the name of the Battle of Badr
